preconditions.description: The number of rounds played is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(name) <= 32 and name.islower() for name, score in rounds)
preconditions.description: Each player's name is a string of lower-case Latin letters with length from 1 to 32.

preconditions.expression: all(-1000 <= score <= 1000 for name, score in rounds)
preconditions.description: Each score is an integer number between -1000 and 1000, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The winner is one of the players who participated in the game.

postconditions.expression: all(players[name] <= players[winner] for name in players)
postconditions.description: The winner has the maximum number of points among all players.

postconditions.expression: all(players[name] < players[winner] or (players[name] == players[winner] and first_reach[name] > first_reach[winner]) for name in players if name != winner)
postconditions.description: If there are multiple players with the maximum number of points, the winner is the one who reached that score first.
